name: house-t1-b-snowy
description: Daub House, the snowy look (ROADMAP 49.10d): the shipped Daub House drawn again as a snow-roof house: its long side to the road under a 45-degree slate roof down to the ground storey, calcite walls on a stone foot, a dormer, a storm porch, deep windows, a lower kitchen gable and a broad stack through the back slope.
